text:
Priya: Heads up  late-night question: flight diverted to Dublin and I grabbed an Airbnb for the night (company trip). Can I expense the Airbnb + cleaning fee?
Jo (People Ops): Yes for emergency diversions it's allowed when no hotel room is available. Please upload: Airbnb invoice PDF, screenshot of booking with dates and guest name, and proof of diversion (boarding pass or airline email).
Sam: Do we treat the Airbnb as lodging actuals or use per-diem?
Jo (People Ops): Lodging is claimed as actuals (so no lodging per-diem). Meals still follow per-diem if you choose that option. If part of stay was personal, prorate and only claim business portion.
Priya: The host only gave a combined total. Is that ok?
Jo (People Ops): Combined total is fine as long as booking PDF shows dates and guest. If the charge is > $200 get manager pre-approval unless truly emergency  then submit and note reason.
TravelBot: Reminder: submit via Expensify, category Lodging -> "Unexpected lodging - diversion". Link: https://intranet.redwood.com/travel-expense
Priya: Thanks, uploaded "airbnb_invoice.pdf" + boardingpass.png and added note about diversion. Pinged my manager.
Jo (People Ops): Got it 44D we'll review and reach out if we need anything else.
